libmpv.dylib and the libraries beside it in the macOS package (Origin.app/Contents/Frameworks: FFmpeg, libass,
HarfBuzz, FreeType, FriBidi, dav1d, Mbed TLS, libxml2, libpng, uchardet) are the unmodified
"libmpv-libs_v0.7.3_macos-arm64-video-full" build of github.com/media-kit/libmpv-darwin-build, release v0.7.3 (SHA-256
of the archive: 9bb168ec908b4801f4231f411e3278a0aea644a2b03ce375c880d2813ab7f949, pinned in tools/macos/build-deps.sh).

It contains mpv 0.36.0 (github.com/mpv-player/mpv) built without its GPL parts, so under the GNU Lesser General Public
License version 2.1 or later (the text in ffmpeg-LGPL-2.1.txt), with FFmpeg and the libraries above under their own
licences. Each is a shared library of its own: it can be rebuilt and replaced.

The complete corresponding source: mpv at v0.36.0, and the build recipe with the exact versions of every library in it
at github.com/media-kit/libmpv-darwin-build (the commit tagged v0.7.3). On request, the maintainers of this app will
provide a copy of that source for at least three years from the release that shipped this file.
